declarations.name: ReclackConnectElement
declarations.description: Connect a wallet, read an address, read a balance.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Where the picker sits: a list on the page, or the whole picker over it.

attributes.name: family
attributes.description: Restricts the list to one chain family. Both when absent.

attributes.name: chain-id
attributes.description: The EVM chain the wallet must end up on. No switch is forced without it.

attributes.name: keep-alive
attributes.description: Hold the connection open afterwards, for a page that signs later.

attributes.name: theme-mode
attributes.description: Light, dark, or whatever the reader’s system says.

attributes.name: brand
attributes.description: #rrggbb. Anything else is ignored and the default stands.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius, as a CSS length.

attributes.name: font
attributes.description: The host’s type, so the picker does not arrive in a different face.

attributes.name: asset-base
attributes.description: Where the host serves this package's assets/ directory from.

attributes.name: api-url
attributes.description: A different Reclack to read the wallet catalogue from, such as a sandbox.

members.name: kit
members.description: A kit to share rather than one this element would make for itself.

members.name: request
members.description: The whole request, for an intent carrying assets.

members.name: theme
members.description: The whole theme, for per-mode overrides.

events.name: connect
events.description: A wallet was connected and the intent resolved.

events.name: cancel
events.description: The picker was closed without connecting.

events.name: connect-error
events.description: Something refused. Named connect-error because every element already has an error event for a resource that failed to load.

cssProperties.name: --rkw-brand
cssProperties.description: The primary action and the focus ring.

cssProperties.name: --rkw-brand-ink
cssProperties.description: Text on the brand colour. Computed when not set.
